author: gpt-5.6-luna
brief: Phase: refactor, migration and dependency upgrade. Role: developer. Repo kind: a Node.js 24 file-processing tool written with node-style callbacks (about 40 files: a pipeline of steps, a retry helper, a file store with callbacks, a CLI, tests, CI config, docs). Inspiration (idea only): public libraries that moved callback code to promises and async functions. Build a task where the owner asks to convert the internals to async functions while the public behaviour stays the same, with wrinkles of your own design (the exported functions must accept both a callback and return a promise for one release, error-first callbacks must still be called exactly once, ordering and concurrency limits of the pipeline stay the same, unhandled rejections must not appear, and the CLI exit codes stay).
